info.what: The single front door to all your backend services.
info.why: It checks who is calling, applies shared rules like rate limits, and forwards each request to the right service, so every service doesn't have to do it.
info.analogy: A hotel reception that checks guests in and points them to the right room.

samples.caption: Routes: which service handles which path
The same rule written as configuration
samples.code:
routes:
  - path: /orders/*
    service: orders-service
    auth: jwt
    rateLimit: 100/minute
